command:
python3 -c "
import shutil, os
from pathlib import Path

repo_root = Path('/home/dev/acme/.worktrees/acme-agy-skills')
starter = repo_root / 'skills/core'
agy_dest = Path(os.path.expanduser('~/.gemini/config/skills'))
agy_dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

manifest = repo_root / 'skills/core/manifest.toml'
import tomllib
with open(manifest, 'rb') as f:
    data = tomllib.load(f)

installed = []
for skill in data.get('skills', []):
    name = skill['name']
    src = starter / name
    if src.is_dir():
        dst = agy_dest / name
        if dst.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(dst)
        shutil.copytree(src, dst, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('.worktrees', 'SKILL.src.md'))
        installed.append(name)
        print(f'Installed {name} -> {dst}')

# Alias: start-review
src = starter / 'run-review'
dst = agy_dest / 'start-review'
if dst.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(dst)
shutil.copytree(src, dst, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('.worktrees', 'SKILL.src.md'))
skill_md = dst / 'SKILL.md'
content = skill_md.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
content = content.replace('run-review', 'start-review').replace('run the review', 'start the review')
skill_md.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')
installed.append('start-review')
print('Installed alias start-review')

# Write manifest receipt
(agy_dest / '.operator-skills-installed.manifest').write_text('\n'.join(sorted(installed)) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print('Wrote manifest receipt')
"
